titles.en: Stele of the Diffusion of the Luminous Religion in China

backgroundZh: 唐人在长安大秦寺立碑，追记景教使团于贞观九年（635）入唐，继而叙其后一百五十年间的兴替。馆方将此石列为世界著名碑刻之一。
background: A Tang stele erected at the Daqin monastery in Chang’an, recording the arrival of the Nestorian mission in 635 and its fortunes for the following century and a half. The museum calls it one of the four famous steles of the world.

review.note: Owner approved for publication on 2026-11-18. Pre-approval evidence note: Draft work record from the museum page. The English title is a project rendering, not a title used by the source.
